landing.heroTitle: Find someone to talk to after the credits roll.
landing.heroSubtitle: Log the films you watch, match with people whose taste lines up with yours, and start with a film you both love.
landing.howItWorksStep1Body: What you loved, what's waiting on your list, what you'll never watch again.
landing.howItWorksStep2Title: Match with people whose taste lines up
landing.howItWorksStep2Body: See your compatibility based on shared favorites and ratings.
landing.howItWorksStep3Title: Start with a film you both love
landing.howItWorksStep3Body: We already have icebreakers ready for your first message.
landing.feature1Body: Log when, where, and who you watched with. See your own year-end recap.
landing.feature2Body: Write down the line that stuck with you — let people who love that scene find you.
landing.feature3Body: Reviews, lists, discussions. Spoilers stay blurred, surprises stay safe.
landing.faqA1: Reelmate is a cinema diary where you log the films you watch — and a way to meet people whose taste matches yours, starting your first conversation from a film you both love.
landing.faqA2: Yes. Your film diary, the feed, and basic messaging are always free. We offer a premium subscription for unlimited swiping and extra features.
landing.faqA3: People who match your film taste, location, and the intent you set (dating, friendship, or a film buddy).
landing.faqA4: No. Alongside dating, there's a mode for friendship and for finding a "film buddy" to go to the cinema or a festival with.
landing.faqQ5: Where does the film data come from?
landing.faqA5: Film information is provided by TMDB; this product is not endorsed or certified by TMDB.
landing.faqQ6: What do you do to keep me safe?
landing.faqA6: We have blocking, reporting, photo and text moderation, location privacy, and a hard block on under-18 sign-ups. See our safety tips page for details.
landing.faqA7: iOS and Android. This website is for discovery and marketing only — there's no account login here.
